messages:
alex: Heads-up — we're kicking off pen test intake for the infra/RBAC/KMS changes next sprint. Need to lock down intake form, triage SLAs, remediation tracking, and a retest window. Who will own intake and the retest coordination? cc: @maria @kevin @tara

sec-bot: :white_check_mark: Pen-test intake received. Generating ticket...

maria: I can own triage and verification checklist. Quick questions: do we want 'critical' to be auto-blocker for deploys until patched + retested? Also what's our expected retest window for critical vs high?

kevin: For KMS rotations I'm proposing we schedule key rotation in a maintenance window and freeze infra deploys 48h before the retest to avoid drift. If we do that, we should document the freeze in the intake.

tara: Compliance note — for any vuln that touches audit logs or KMS we need to preserve immutable logs for 90 days and produce an evidence bundle for auditors. Also SOC2 requires timeline artifacts for triage & remediation.

jordan: Suggest we tag all issues with 'pen-test' and use the existing security JIRA board. I can own scheduling the retest slots and runbook for the verifier.

alex: Proposal for SLAs: initial ack within 24h, remediation plan within 3 business days for critical, fix + retest request within 7 days. For high: plan within 5 business days, retest request within 14 days. Thoughts?

maria: +1 on the SLAs. Also recommend we require a minimal repro or PoC for each finding to avoid wasted cycles. If vendor reports a finding without PoC, triage to 'needs repro' and assign to intake owner.

kevin: For the KMS/RBAC scope: include service accounts, node pools that assume roles, and any cross-account key policies. Sample command to freeze deploys on our infra envs:

```
# freeze deploys in infra
./infra-lock --env=prod --reason="pen-test freeze" --duration=48h
```

Add this to the intake checklist.

sec-bot: New pen-test ticket created: PT-2024-87. Intake form: https://intranet.redwood/pen-tests/PT-2024-87

sam: If we surface a critical vuln that impacts customers, we need a comms plan. Who drafts the initial customer-safe notice? We should have a template.

maria: I'll draft the disclosure template and remediation verification checklist. Template should include safe summary, customer impact (yes/no), mitigations, and ETA for fix.

jordan: For retest coordination: I can provide retest windows Mon-Fri 09:00-17:00 PT, need at least 48h notice before booking. Verifier will be @maria or an external pen vendor — please indicate preference in the intake form.

alex: Action items: (1) @maria owns triage & PoC requirement; (2) @jordan owns scheduling & JIRA tagging; (3) @kevin owns infra freeze/KMS runbook; (4) @tara owns compliance evidence bundle; (5) I will own the retest SLA enforcement. We'll update the intake form with the freeze command, evidence retention, and retest windows.

maria: One more: for RBAC tests, add a matrix of roles + allowed actions (export CSV) so triage can reproduce least-privilege failures quickly.

kevin: Noted. I'll export the current role matrix and drop it in the ticket.

sec-bot: PT-2024-87 updated: attachments added (role-matrix.csv, kms-rotation-plan.md).

alex: Great — let's reconvene after the intake form is updated. If anyone sees blockers (tooling access, audit retention config), call it out here. :thumbsup:
